text: Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for time-series prediction and processing. They consist of a large, sparsely connected hidden layer called the "reservoir," which is typically not trained. Instead, the weights of the reservoir are fixed, and only the output weights are adjusted during training. Reservoirs in ESNs are often trained using random connectivity and spectral radius tuning to ensure they can capture the dynamics of the input signal effectively.
